title: Telemetry Concordance Watchdog for Usage/Cost/Latency
creator: Liam Chen
description: Build a 'concordance' anomaly detection and alerting service that correlates usage, cost, and latency signals across Console backend services and the usage analytics pipeline. The service will surface high-confidence incidents where the three-signal coherence deviates from expected relationships (for example: sustained cost rise without proportional usage, or latency spike without CPU/memory increase), provide triage hints, and route alarms to the appropriate on-call with suggested remediation steps.
acceptance_criteria: Realtime ingestion: consolidated telemetry (usage events, per-request latency, cost attribution) available in the anomaly service within 2 minutes of generation
Concordance score computed per-customer and per-route with configurable window sizes (1m, 5m, 1h) and baseline period
Alerting: create PagerDuty incident with metadata when concordance score crosses threshold + confidence > 0.85
Automated triage suggestions include likely root cause markers (e.g., batch size growth, cache miss rate, KV cache warming, routing fallbacks) and top-3 correlated signals
Dashboards: Console dashboard with per-customer concordance heatmap and explanation panel (links to example queries and last 72h contributing signals)
Backfill: historical run over last 30 days produces SLO for false positive rate < 5% on sampled customers and recall > 80% for known incidents from Jan-Mar 2026
notes: Rationale: existing single-signal detectors generate noisy alerts; concordance approach aims to reduce noise by requiring cross-signal corroboration

Design trade-offs considered: lightweight rules (fast, interpretable) vs ML models (better recall). We will start with hybrid: EWMA + rule-based heuristics plus optional isolation-forest scoring for enrichment
Privacy: cost and usage data contain customer identifiers; service must respect existing PII access controls and support per-tenant redaction in alert payloads
Scaling: expected peak QPS for telemetry ingestion ~10k events/s; initial rollout targets sample of top 500 customers before cluster autoscaling
Observability: include explainability tokens (top contributing features) in alerts to reduce on-call time-to-diagnosis

implementation_plan: Phase 1 (sampled rollout): build ingestion consumer + concordance scorer service, wire alerts to staging PD, run 30-day backfill for calibration
Phase 2 (production rollout): enable for top-500 customers, expose Console dashboard and allow toggle per-tenant
Phase 3 (automation): add automatic remediation suggestions and integrate with routing fallback metrics to support automatic mitigations
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: false negatives for novel failure modes where signals decouple in unusual ways. Mitigation: keep single-signal detectors in parallel and surface their outputs in alert context
Risk: increased cost from backfills and enrichment models. Mitigation: sample-based enrichment and throttled backfill windows
Risk: noisy alerts due to billing attribution delays. Mitigation: include attribution-lag feature and lower confidence for recent data
